scope: Argent gestures on the story timeline and shared briefing scrubber; inspect rendered UI and React/shared-value state.

fixes.issue: Delayed JS commit from an earlier drag moved a newer held playhead back to the earlier story.
fixes.reproduction: Block JS for 2500 ms; scrub x=.5 to .25 at y=.934, release; immediately drag x=.5 to .75 and hold. Inspect after queued callbacks drain.
fixes.change: Optional useScrub snapTo worklet settles taps and releases on UI. StoryDock JS commit only selects the story; it no longer writes the shared playhead.
fixes.verification: Recorded race replay asserts held fraction after a 3000 ms drain, then asserts released story equals preview and deck position equals index.

fixes.issue: Briefing tooltip rounded to nearest second while elapsed time rounded down.
fixes.change: Preview uses Math.floor, matching playback elapsed seconds.

checks: First/last story seeks; out-of-track horizontal endpoints clamp.
Sixteen reversals within one held drag; final preview agrees with selected story.
Twelve alternating 80 ms seeks with no inter-gesture delay, including expanded story.
Long held preview, then reverse and release.
Diagonal drag outside the track after activation; final position clamps.
Vertical drag rejects without selecting another story.
Two-finger input completes and clears holding.
Tap within already-selected story snaps back to its marker.
Home during held story drag restores committed position.
Audio playing advances elapsed while held fraction stays fixed.
Paused audio seeks to both endpoints and rapidly reverses.
Post-fix audio tooltip and released whole seconds agree.
Post-fix Home during held paused audio cancels: elapsed stays 91, holding=0, shown=0 after return.
Post-fix broad flow: 8 passed, 0 failed/errored/skipped; final story and preview agree, holding=0, tooltip settles hidden.
Runtime log: 2 app-start log entries, no warnings or errors.

testEvidence.before: Two new snap/cancellation regressions failed before implementation.
testEvidence.full: npm run verify: typecheck, Biome, deprecated API check, 105 suites / 1060 tests passed.

limitations: Android emulator validation; not an iOS or physical-device performance claim.
Starting a drag in the Android system Back edge can leave the app. Verified cancellation separately; repeatable in-app flow begins away from that edge.
Story indices and headlines vary with feed time; regression compares the live preview and selected story.
cleanup: No release, deployment or commit. User-owned Metro preserved.
